# Crimson Halls wall kit (first art-style pass)

Roadmap step 2 (`docs/art-roadmap.md`). Red brick, gold trim, demon-skull details, PS2 / Snake Eater low poly,
built to match the 1911 test (`assets/models/gun/pistol_1911_ps2.glb`): one material, one 256 px atlas,
nearest filtering, diffuse only (metallic 0), hard-edged pixel texture. **Art only: the game does not load these yet.**

## Pieces

All exported with `tools/blender/export_lowpoly.py --type prop` (limit 500 tris). Each piece is one mesh,
one material, one draw call. Every GLB embeds the same 256x256 atlas.

| File | Triangles | Verts | Size (m, W x D x H) | Origin |
|------|-----------|-------|---------------------|--------|
| `ch_wall_straight.glb` | 54 | 37 | 2 x 0.66 x 4 | bottom of the room face, centre |
| `ch_wall_corner.glb` | 118 | 96 | 2.5 x 2.66 x 4 (inner L) | as the straight wall it replaces; 2nd arm runs 2 m toward the room on its left |
| `ch_doorway_arch.glb` | 200 | 133 | 4 x 0.66 x 4, opening 2 x 3.25 | bottom of the room face, centre |
| `ch_pillar.glb` | 150 | 88 | 0.8 x 0.8 x 4 | bottom centre |
| `ch_floor_tile.glb` | 10 | 8 | 2 x 2 x 0.1 | top centre (walk surface at 0) |
| `ch_torch_sconce.glb` | 72 | 53 | 0.2 x 0.38 x 0.63 | where the back plate meets the wall; `flame` empty 0.28 out, 0.28 up |
| `ch_banner.glb` (bonus) | 26 | 28 | 1 x 0.08 x 2.3 | middle of the rod, on the wall |

## Conventions

- glTF: +Y up, metres. The **room side of every wall faces +Z** (Blender -Y). Thickness goes to -Z.
- Grid 2 m = the game's `CELL`. Walls are 4 m modules; the game's `WALL_H` is 11.5 m, so tall halls stack
  modules or scale Y (brick tiles are 2 m, so stacking at 4 m steps stays seamless).
- Brick, floor and capstone UVs tile on 2 m / 1 m boundaries, so pieces snapped on 0.5 m steps line up.
- Torch light: the game already puts its torch light 0.28 m off the wall at y 2.85. Mount the sconce origin at
  y 2.57 on the wall so the `flame` empty sits on that light. The flame is opaque geometry (no alpha blending).
- Root node extras: `{"kit": "crimson_halls", "grid_m": 2}`.

## Rebuild

From the repo root: `assets/models/env/crimson_halls/export_all.sh` (build atlas + .blend files, export every GLB
through the pipeline exporter, render previews to `/workspace/crimson_halls_previews`).
`crimson_halls_kit.blend` holds every piece side by side; the per-piece .blend files the exporter reads are
temporary and regenerated by `build_crimson_halls.py`.

## Palette

mortar, 4 brick reds, 3 dark stones, 3 golds, 2 irons, 3 flame colours (16 total). Lighting is not baked:
the "low gold light" comes from the game's warm torch lights plus the gold trim.
